id: title:jakesciotto:retry a gladly report served as an error body

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and transient failure recovery
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H4 demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement: it adds a new exception class, a helper to distinguish report availability, and a retry decorator. This allows the Gladly warehouse connector to distinguish between a missing-column error and an unavailable report, and retry the unavailable-report case. This could prevent transient failures from permanently failing
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that transient unavailability occurs and that retrying resolves it, which is not demonstrated by the code execution or test results. No tests are shown. The removal of docstrings and unused imports does not contribute to tier 2. No tier 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class GladlyReportUnavailableError and a helper _header_is_an_error_line, and wraps report fetching with a retry decorator. The helper checks if the header has exactly one field, treating it as an error line. The retry decorator is configured to retry on GladlyReportUnavailableError.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion. The connector now distinguishes between a missing-column error and an unavailable report, and retries the unavailable-report case. This could prevent transient failures from permanently failing a warehouse sync. The connection is plausible and demonstrated.
